items.one_liner: A race condition in the LatePoint WordPress plugin allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass OTP lockouts and hijack user accounts.
items.summary: The Appointment Booking Plugin (LatePoint) for WordPress is vulnerable to an unauthenticated authentication bypass (CVE-2026-110653) due to a race condition in its OTP verification process. items.title: How Israeli firm’s ‘zero-click’ malware attack poses global security risk
items.one_liner: Israeli spyware firm Candiru used zero-click malicious advertisements to compromise mobile and laptop devices used by Al Jazeera journalists.
items.summary: Security researchers have uncovered the first-known instance of zero-click targeted advertising malware deployed by Israeli spyware firm Candiru against Al Jazeera journalists. In June 2025, 45 staff devices were compromised without requiring user interaction beyond viewing a malicious advertisement served via Discover-Tech, an advertising firm acting as a facilitator. The ads automatically redirected targets to Candiru's infected servers, exploiting browser vulnerabilities to bypass sandboxes and extract sensitive personal data including files, credentials, keystrokes, and webcam streams. The campaign highlights the evolution of mercenary spyware toward silent, microtargeted ad-delivery vectors that operate without user clicks.
key_facts: Target organization: Al Jazeera (45 devices targeted)
items.bottom_line: Zero-click malware delivered through automated ad networks represents an advanced surveillance vector capable of silently compromising devices upon mere page views.

claims.text: An Israeli spyware firm has been found to be behind the first-known instance of “zero-click” targeted advertising in which fraudsters or spies can steal private data and send it to external servers, with Al Jazeera journalists among the victims.
claims.support_span: An Israeli spyware firm has been found to be behind the first-known instance of “zero-click” targeted advertising in which fraudsters or spies can steal private data and send it to external servers, with Al Jazeera journalists among the victims.

claims.text: In June 2025, 45 devices used by Al Jazeera staff – including several who reported on sensitive subjects – were targeted with spyware which installed itself without the need to open or download any files.

items.title: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
items.one_liner: Stack Overflow tripled signups for its AI agent platform using a ChatGPT plugin built with OpenAI Codex.
items.summary: Stack Overflow utilized OpenAI's Codex and a new ChatGPT plugin to accelerate product development and distribution for Stack Overflow for Agents. Two engineers built the agent product within a few weeks using Codex, and the introduction of a ChatGPT plugin tripled overnight user signups while increasing agent creation tenfold. Additionally, Codex reduced enterprise connector development times from 3–6 weeks down to 4 days, significantly shortening time-to-market.
items.bottom_line: Stack Overflow leveraged OpenAI Codex and a ChatGPT plugin to triple agent platform signups and accelerate engineering velocity.

items.title: How Third Moment Research runs 10,000 agents for 36+ hours
items.one_liner: AI labs are scaling autonomous research with thousands of concurrent agents over multi-day sessions.
items.summary: Third Moment Research runs 10,000 concurrent AI agents for 36 to 48 hours using OpenAI models like GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, and Codex to conduct autonomous quantitative research. By leveraging Codex to analyze simulation trajectories, the lab identified a major backtesting bottleneck and deployed a caching optimization that reduced simulation times from three hours to a few minutes. The setup combines Dockerized environments with specialized outer harnesses to maintain long-horizon coherence and manage agent workflows effectively.
key_facts: Backtest Reduction: 3 hours down to 3 to 5 minutes
items.bottom_line: Advanced agent harnesses and model reasoning enable long-horizon autonomous research sessions lasting over 36 hours.

claims.text: Third Moment Research runs 10,000 concurrent agents for 36 to 48 hours using OpenAI models like GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, and Codex to conduct autonomous quantitative research.

items.title: Repeal recent Assembly polls, INDIA bloc urges President
items.one_liner: India's opposition bloc petitioned the President to repeal recent assembly elections and replace EVMs with paper ballots over alleged vote theft.
items.summary: The opposition INDIA bloc petitioned President Droupadi Murmu to repeal all assembly elections held over the past two years, claiming they possess incontrovertible evidence of widespread vote theft ("vote chori"). Opposition leaders, including Rahul Gandhi, alleged that electronic voting machines have compromised democracy and called for a return to paper ballots, the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, and the repeal of laws granting immunity to election commissioners. The bloc plans to present a similar memorandum to Chief Justice of India Surya Kant. Rahul Gandhi asserted that continued pressure could force the central government to collapse before completing its term.
items.bottom_line: The political standoff between the opposition INDIA bloc and the government escalates as leaders formally request the President to nullify recent elections and overhaul the election commission.
